page.layout: One page of an index in two columns, left and right. Heading "INDEX." centred above both columns. Left column first, then right column, each read top to bottom. A short fragment "befi" closes the right column at the foot. No margin notes, no running head, no page number, no catchword.
page.notes: The final line "befi" is cut off at the foot of the page; the printed mark after it may be a fragment of "befi(s)" or a bullet, so I have left it as [?]-free but unconfirmed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The index marks "pōt" and "pō" and "pont" are kept as printed. The line "Imperatorum titulo in-" has a faint "in-" that could be "in-" or "in" with a hyphen; kept as printed. The entry "Imperatorem à pōt. Ro." reads "pōt" with a macron as printed.
